question: On which mountain was the blessing to be proclaimed, and on which the curse?
options: Blessing on Sinai, curse on Horeb
Blessing on Gerizim, curse on Ebal
Blessing on Nebo, curse on Pisgah
Blessing on Hor, curse on Seir
explanation: Moses said the blessings were to be proclaimed on Mount Gerizim and the curses on Mount Ebal when Israel entered the land.
